name: Unwa BS-RoFormer HyperACE v2 Inst
weights: Convert v2_inst/bs_roformer_inst_hyperacev2.ckpt from https://huggingface.co/pcunwa/BS-Roformer-HyperACE with candle-roformer's tools/convert_hyperace.py. Use configs/bs_roformer_hyperace_v2_inst.yaml from candle-roformer 1.0.2, including its explicit family and instrumental target.

name: BS-RoFormer Viperx 1297 (vocals)
weights: Download the published .ckpt named in configs/bs_roformer_viperx_1297.yaml, then convert it to safetensors with candle-roformer's tools/convert_bs_roformer.py. The checksum is for the source checkpoint.

name: GaboxR67 voc_fv7 (vocals)
weights: Obtain voc_fv7.ckpt from the source identified in candle-roformer's configs/voc_fv7.yaml and convert it with tools/convert_voc_fv7.py.

name: KimberleyJSN MelBandRoformer 384 (vocals)
weights: Obtain the f32 safetensors checkpoint published by the Kijai mirror; its model profile is candle-roformer's configs/kijai_melband_384.yaml.
